notice: Delivery Planning contract: who builds, with how many parallel fronts and for when (declare), how long the plan will take and whether it fits (plan), and how the real work compares (measure). Data only. The CLI and the site read the questions through the declared operations (delivery.questions) and never write their own texts. Everything here is computed from files by .gtt/scripts/gtt-delivery.sh: the agent explains and proposes, it never decides.

prompt.en: Who is going to build this?

label.es: Yo, con varios agentes en paralelo
label.en: Me, with several agents in parallel

label.es: Un equipo de personas, cada una con su agente
label.en: A team of people, each with their own agent

prompt.en: How many parallel fronts can you sustain?

note.es: Depende de los límites de uso de tu plan del agente. Si es un equipo, se piden los nombres, que serán los dueños de cada frente.
note.en: It depends on the usage limits of your agent plan. For a team, the names are asked: they own the fronts.

label.es: No sé: GTT propone según el diseño
label.en: I do not know: GTT proposes from the design

prompt.es: ¿Para cuándo necesitas una primera versión usable?
prompt.en: When do you need a first usable version?

label.es: Llegar rápido: recortar y usar servicios existentes
label.en: Arrive fast: cut scope and use existing services

prompt.es: ¿Puedes usar servicios de terceros para lo genérico (login, cobros, correo, archivos)?
prompt.en: Can you use third-party services for the generic parts (login, payments, email, files)?

note.es: Las restricciones también llegan a constraints.md como [PROPUESTA].
note.en: Restrictions also reach constraints.md as a [PROPUESTA].

prompt.es: GTT te avisará cuando un Epic pase de un día completo de agente (8 h). ¿Te sirve ese tope?
prompt.en: GTT will warn you when an Epic goes over one full agent day (8 h). Does that cap work for you?

selection.unanswered: OPEN - nothing is invented; a missing answer is shown as OPEN
selection.state_authority: none - an operating answer, not architecture; it can change at any time (gtt delivery set) because it governs how the work is organised, not what is built

fields.estimate_format: `<n>h` agent hours, optionally `+ <n> decisions` human decision points; never weeks of a person
fields.budget_values: ok | over - accepted: <reason> - <who> - <YYYY-MM-DD> | over - split | over - cut | over - integrate

signals.DLV-STORY-OVER: a Story In Progress for more than story_over_ratio x its estimate
signals.DLV-EPIC-BUDGET: an Epic over its cap with no decision in Budget
signals.DLV-FORECAST: the forecast finish is after the deadline
signals.DLV-HUMAN-WAIT: a human action (Owner: human) open for more than human_wait_h
signals.DLV-LANE-CROSS: Epics of different fronts declare overlapping Touches
signals.DLV-NO-VALUE: no Epic of Kind slice or skeleton, with a development method declared

levels_owned_by: .gtt/contract/profiles.json (profiles.<id>.delivery) - each Autonomy Profile defines what a signal means for it

verification.freeze: gtt-delivery.sh check --pre-freeze: every Planned Epic has an Estimate; an Epic over its cap carries the decision in Budget; with more than one front every Epic has Lane and Touches and no two fronts overlap; every `Build: integrate (ADR-NNN)` names an ADR that exists; every external [FUENTE: ..., consultado AAAA-MM-DD] is younger than source_max_age_days
verification.silent_when: no .gtt/delivery.json and no Epic with a delivery field: a project that never declared delivery planning is never obstructed

boundary: GTT plans and watches the fronts. It does not launch, create or orchestrate agents: that belongs to the ADE. `lanes` only prints summaries and the `git worktree add` commands to copy.
